description: This file defines an API service for fetching dashboard data, including mock data generation for development and real API calls for production. It includes functions to generate realistic fluctuations in system metrics like memory and CPU usage, and exports a function to retrieve dashboard data.

methods.name: getFluctuation
methods.description: Generates a random fluctuation between min and max values.

methods.name: clamp
methods.description: Ensures a value stays within specified min and max bounds.

methods.name: generateMockData
methods.description: Creates mock dashboard data with simulated fluctuations for development environment.

methods.name: getDashboardData
methods.description: Main exported function to fetch dashboard data, either mock or real API call based on environment.
